description: This Java class 'GatewayMetricsService' manages and reports gateway metrics for MQTT transport in the Thingsboard platform. It schedules periodic reporting, processes session and device data, and sends telemetry messages.

classes.name: GatewayMetricsService
classes.description: Service class for managing and reporting gateway metrics in MQTT transport.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the service and schedules periodic metrics reporting.

methods.name: process
methods.description: Processes session info and device data to update metrics state.

methods.name: onDeviceUpdate
methods.description: Updates session info for a specific device.

methods.name: onDeviceDelete
methods.description: Removes device metrics state upon device deletion.

methods.name: reportMetrics
methods.description: Reports accumulated metrics for all gateways.

methods.name: reportMetrics (private)
methods.description: Generates and sends telemetry data for a specific gateway's metrics.
